ohchr-special-procedures.name: OHCHR: How to submit information to the Special Procedures
ohchr-special-procedures.applicability: For individuals, groups and civil society organizations to check the submission requirements of the Special Procedures. Whether to act is up to the relevant experts; an automatic acknowledgement does not mean they have intervened. This is not a judicial process, and a country-visit recommendation is different from submitting an individual case. Confirm the person’s consent, disclosure choices and safety risks first.
requiredMaterials: A clear, credible and specific account of what happened and the alleged violation
Key supporting material matching the account; media reports alone are not enough
The person’s or their representative’s explicit view on disclosing their name to the parties concerned and in public reports
ohchr-special-procedures.summary: Submit credible, detailed information for mandate holders to decide whether to act.
eligibility: Check the mandate; prior exhaustion of domestic remedies is not required for these communications.
Information cannot rely exclusively on media reports; confirm consent and identity-disclosure risks.

cpj-emergency-help.name: Committee to Protect Journalists (CPJ): Journalist safety and emergencies
cpj-emergency-help.applicability: Case-by-case, short-term emergency support for working journalists and media workers facing incidents linked to their journalism. Urgent situations come first, and a response or funding is not guaranteed; bloggers and activists cannot be assumed to qualify by identity alone. The page notes that information may be shared with a few trusted partners for verification.
requiredMaterials: A description of the person’s journalism and relevant work
The incident, current needs, and how they connect to the person’s journalism
First confirm with the person what help to ask for and what information may be shared
cpj-emergency-help.summary: Journalist safety and emergency-assistance contact. Crisis situations are prioritized; not every request can receive a response.
eligibility: Explain the journalism and its connection to the incident.
The organization assesses requests; response, representation or funding is not guaranteed.
unknowns: Team review is pending; applicability to a particular case and current procedural requirements are not established.
